description: LstG Skyfallskartering Ljungby tätort is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lantmäteriet. Low-point mapping showing trapped areas in Lessebo urban area in Kronoberg County. The depth at low points is divided into 7 depth classes 0,5-10, 10-20, 21-30, 31-50, 51-70, 71-100 and 101-350 cm. The material is based on the survey's height scan with 2 meters resolution but has been generalized to a resolution of 4 meters. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "LstG Skyfall mapping Ljungby urban area" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2024-03-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
